titles.title: runShaper, run mode: an unfocused request on a module gets a stamped bundle, and each step is handed the resolved scope
runShaper, run mode: a refused pairing fails before the scope is resolved or any step runs
runShaper, run mode: a scope outside every registered repo fails as not indexed before any step runs
runShaper, run mode: a cause becomes its typed error and does NOT fall through to the tool loop
runShaper's run-mode bundle carries the report derived from the executed lookups
a lookup that returns no completeness record is listed as failed, and the answer is still written from the other lookups
a request answered by the free-form lookup alone returns a bundle with a one-source 'model-directed' report
a bundle cached before the change is not returned
the tool loop's final answer is asked for with a schema that has no report, and a classification bundle carries none

runShaper: a lastIndexedAt that throws ends as ShaperIndexStateReadError (code 'index-state-read-failed'), through the one injectable reader (PipelineSteps.lastIndexedAt), at runShaper's freshness read and inside the pipeline

runShaper cache order: a cache hit does not call scope resolution (a scopeDeps that throws is never reached) and returns the bundle; a hit on a connection scope while another repository's connections file is broken returns the bundle
runShaper: a cache hit for a bundle whose repository is now being indexed is refused with RepoIndexingError and the bundle is not returned; a bundle without repoPath is a miss
runShaper: a cache hit whose recorded repository was reindexed since (newer last-indexed time) is a miss and the request is built
bundle schema: a freshly built bundle with repoPath (a string and null) passes validateBundleWithErrors; an older bundle without it still validates
runShaper: a connection-scope bundle (repoPath null) is served from cache without the indexing and freshness checks

runShaper: a cache hit decides the index state by the same rule as a miss: a generic run, or a run whose caller checked the scope, about a repository being indexed is served from a warm cache as it would be built from a cold one; a code run is refused
runShaper: a cache hit on a code run whose recorded repository the index no longer holds is refused as not indexed, as the same request is from a cold cache

runShaper (ISSUE-0c845762): a docs run on a scope the index does not hold (in no registered repository, or in a registered repository with no stored entities) is refused as not indexed before any lookup or model call, cold and warm, with the run's message; a caller that checked the scope already is not checked again
